mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at its current level of 0.1% is indicative of an extremely accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 270) signals an imminent monetary policy tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 270, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% and monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) is below 0.5%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that triggers recession fears, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 600000, it indicates a strong consumer demand environment that supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 600000, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector that reduces economic growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it indicates a dual shock to the economy (supply contraction and labor market deterioration), leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
